question.text: Tests of market efficiency include all EXCEPT:

explanation.text: The Logic: Runs + autocorrelation + event studies are EMH tests. Stress tests are risk-management tools, not efficiency tests. The Trap: Stress tests look at tail risk, not predictability. Cross-Exam Context: Research methods. Manager's Pro-Tip: Combine multiple tests — no single test 'proves' efficiency; the body of evidence matters.
